recovery.title: Recovery acceptance
recovery.summary: First re-establish the one live judgment left by the shutdown, then exercise the creator loop as a fresh imported fork.

cold_load.title: Cold-load the canonical Demo World
cold_load.instruction: Load Comfy Quest Demo once and judge the breadcrumb/sign path from hub arrival. Do not rebuild the Gallery and do not repeat the already-proven Charm lap.
cold_load.verdict: Was CAST HERE and its Arcane Sight breadcrumb path immediately obvious from hub arrival?
cold_load.source_contains: acceptance step is one cold load and one human judgment

creator_flow.title: Exercise the imported-fork creator loop
creator_flow.summary: Use the checked-in schema-v3 project. Import creates fresh identities, so the canonical artifact remains untouched and the first fork needs one fresh CAST.
creator_flow.heading: Public creator loop

revision_flow.title: Prove one later revision of the same fork
revision_flow.summary: This is the live-unverified edit/Rehearse/Play/rebind loop. Keep the imported fork IDs, make one content-only change, and let the armed Runtime pull it.
revision_flow.source_sequence: Author -> Rehearse -> arm once in F9 -> Play this revision -> play -> inspect proof
revision_flow.source_contains: Author -> Rehearse -> arm once in F9 -> Play this revision -> play -> inspect proof
revision_flow.edit_source_contains: The First Portal answers. Your quest is complete.
revision_flow.suggested_edit: In the imported fork, change the completion message to ‘The First Portal answers again. Your quest is complete.’ Keep the targetless portal trigger unchanged.

phase3_lap.summary: This is queued behind recovery acceptance. Its sequence and human verdicts are rendered directly from the derived session-3 runbook.

cautions: A worktree isolates Git, not the shared Valheim installation. Take one install-wide owner before an automated live lap.
Rehearsal proves evaluator behavior and declares its own limitations; it does not prove Unity, BepInEx, Harmony, or live mutation.
Restoring only world files does not reset durable Runtime completion state. Do not improvise a replay reset that the product has not proven.
The i5 peer is unnecessary for content-only creator-loop changes; use captured multiplayer scenarios unless an event adapter changes.
